mapper.update: UPDATE word_learning_card SET del_is=1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE generator_version IN (#{generatorV1},#{generatorV2},#{generatorV3}) AND del_is=0
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT cv.id AS version_id,LOWER(TRIM(cv.word_term)) AS word_term,cv.meaning FROM vocabulary_book vb JOIN vocabulary_book_word vbw ON vbw.book_id=vb.id JOIN learning_content lc ON lc.id=vbw.content_id JOIN content_version cv ON cv.id=lc.published_version_id WHERE vb.state='active' AND vb.level_code IN ('primary','junior','senior','cet4','cet6') AND lc.content_type='word' AND lc.state='published' AND lc.withdrawn_at IS NULL AND cv.review_status='approved' ORDER BY word_term,version_id

SELECT ws.content_version_id AS version_id,ws.part_of_speech,ws.meaning FROM word_sense ws WHERE ws.content_version_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT cv2.id FROM vocabulary_book vb2 JOIN vocabulary_book_word vbw2 ON vbw2.book_id=vb2.id JOIN learning_content lc2 ON lc2.id=vbw2.content_id JOIN content_version cv2 ON cv2.id=lc2.published_version_id WHERE vb2.state='active' AND vb2.level_code IN ('primary','junior','senior','cet4','cet6') AND lc2.content_type='word' AND lc2.state='published' AND lc2.withdrawn_at IS NULL AND cv2.review_status='approved') ORDER BY ws.content_version_id,ws.sort_no
SELECT * FROM word_lexical_relation_evidence WHERE dataset_code=#{datasetCode} AND del_is=0 ORDER BY headword_norm,relation_type,related_term

SELECT content_version_id,card_key,card_type,del_is,state,review_status,reviewed_at,rights_status FROM word_learning_card WHERE content_version_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT cv2.id FROM vocabulary_book vb2 JOIN vocabulary_book_word vbw2 ON vbw2.book_id=vb2.id JOIN learning_content lc2 ON lc2.id=vbw2.content_id JOIN content_version cv2 ON cv2.id=lc2.published_version_id WHERE vb2.state='active' AND vb2.level_code IN ('primary','junior','senior','cet4','cet6') AND lc2.content_type='word' AND lc2.state='published' AND lc2.withdrawn_at IS NULL AND cv2.review_status='approved')
